text:
maria: Heads-up: prepping a parallel-region soft rollout for r-2026.03.22b. Flag is `llm_route_v2`. Plan is staggered slices across regions (US/EU/APAC): 0% -> 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over ~45m. Change window 03:00-05:00 UTC. ping @sre and @qa :spiral_calendar:

kevin: ack. I'll take watch and handle incident comms if anything trips. Who owns baseline numbers?

tarun: I will pin canary routing to `model-llm-v2.4-quant-lite` on the canary and warm pools. Fallback is `model-llm-v2.2-stable`. We'll apply pins before any traffic shift.

maria: Rollback/abort criteria (explicit):
- sustained 5xx rate >= 1.0% for >= 3 minutes
- p95 latency > 1.8x baseline for >= 8 minutes
- 99th latency increase > 300ms sustained for 5 minutes
- automated QA eval drop >= 5% absolute on smoke suite
If any trigger: set `llm_route_v2` -> 0% immediately, pin routing back to `model-llm-v2.2-stable`, and notify #eng-oncall.

qa-bot: QA will run smoke-suite at each ramp step (10/30/60). Posting pass/fail + small diff.

sre-bot: Creating temp monitors: p95, p99, 5xx rate, token-cost-index. Alerts will notify #eng-oncall and @kevin. Links to monitors will be posted when ready.

deploy-bot: INFO: queued flag change `llm_route_v2` for r-2026.03.22b by maria. Will execute scheduled ramp and post step updates.

maria: Operational runbook (high level):
1) 03:05 UTC 1 pin canary to `model-llm-v2.4-quant-lite` on canary+warm pools only
2) 03:12 UTC 1 ramp to 10% (small cohorted slices across regions)
3) 03:22 UTC 1 evaluate telemetry + QA smoke results
4) 03:30 UTC 1 ramp to 30%
5) 03:40 UTC 1 evaluate, then 60% at ~03:50 UTC
6) 04:00 UTC 1 finish to 100% if green, then remove pins by 04:10

Tarun: Quick mitigation snippets for ops if we need to act fast (use rwdctl for quicker invocation):
```
# emergency: drop traffic to 0%
rwdctl flags set llm_route_v2 --percent 0 --reason "emergency"

# partial: split to 20% while keeping canary pinned
rwdctl flags set llm_route_v2 --percent 20 --cohort us-west
```

kevin: I'll be on-call watch 03:10-04:15. If I see any alert and no immediate rollback, I'll call the team and escalate.

sre-bot: UPDATE: monitors ready. p95 baseline 125ms, p99 340ms, 5xx baseline 0.09%, token-cost-index 1.0. Alert links: https://ops.redwood/alerts/73821 (p95), https://ops.redwood/alerts/73822 (5xx)

deploy-bot: ACTION 03:06 UTC: canary pin applied to pools canary-1 and warm-2.

deploy-bot: ACTION 03:13 UTC: ramped `llm_route_v2` to 10% across cohorts.

qa-bot: 03:15 UTC smoke: PASS. minor diffs on a conversational prompt (down 1.6%), within threshold.

kevin: telemetry 03:18 UTC: p95 140ms (baseline 125), p99 360ms, 5xx 0.15%, token-cost-index 1.02. All green vs thresholds.

sre-bot: NOTE: temporary alerting silence added for low-noise during ramp (will still fire on breach).

deploy-bot: ACTION 03:31 UTC: ramped to 30%.

qa-bot: 03:33 UTC smoke: PASS. one case flagged for reviewer but delta < 2%.

kevin: small blip 03:36 UTC - p99 hit 420ms for ~90s on one EU shard; p95 steady. I investigated logs, looks like GC spike on node set EU-x. SRE is looking. Not hitting rollback thresholds.

sre-bot: 03:38 UTC: mitigated GC via rolling restart on EU-x. p99 recovering.

deploy-bot: ACTION 03:51 UTC: ramped to 60%.

qa-bot: 03:53 UTC smoke: PASS. no eval drops >5%.

kevin: 03:58 UTC final warm check: p95 142ms, p99 300ms, 5xx 0.11%. All within limits. No manual holds.

deploy-bot: ACTION 04:06 UTC: ramped to 100% and marking rollout complete.

maria: Removing pins at 04:10 UTC and updating release notes. Release note snippet: "r-2026.03.22b: rolled default routing to llm-v2.4-quant-lite via staged parallel-region ramp; monitored p95/p99/5xx/cost; defined rollback criteria and recovery steps."

sre-bot: NOTE: temp monitors will auto-expire in 4 hours. Extend if you need more retention.

deploy-bot: COMPLETE: parallel-region soft rollout finished. For emergency rollback tag `@deploy-bot rollback llm_route_v2` or run the rwdctl command above. If anyone wants the step logs, ping me and I'll dump timestamps and cohort slices.
